statement: Model: one walk from spawn in a uniformly random direction (THEORY.md 1). Hard bounds: geometry error 0, rounding at most 0.5 blocks (included). Random part: except with chance at most 1e-06 over the seeds (A1, A2), every range below holds at once (Theorem 20). The lower end of every E[D] range needs nothing more; the upper end also uses H_C (constant hazard from C/2 on), which affects only the tail share.
